t.rel: It has taken in many refugees from South Sudan and the DRC. It has often sent troops into neighbors' conflicts and took part in peacekeeping in Somalia for a long time. With Kenya and Tanzania it forms the East African Community.
t.know: About half the world's mountain gorillas live there.
t.etext: It sells coffee and gold and is developing oil fields near Lake Albert. Trade with South Sudan and the DRC is big too.
